text: Implemented exact parsed-entity LNA queries. LnaDatasetQuery now supports run/acq/desc labels; LnaDataset parses .lna.h5 filename entities and matches subject/session/task/run/acq/space/desc exactly instead of substring filtering; resolveLnaFile returns typed LnaDatasetLookupError for scan/no-match/ambiguous cases while readSubject/readSubjectLatent/readSubjectMaterialized preserve ArchiveError adapters. Updated docs/module-relations.md to match the live dataset -> bids boundary and README to document exact LNA lookup. Tests: sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test passed (41 JVM tests, 29 JS tests); git diff --check over dataset/model/module docs passed.
